experiment: X11 ReleaseAll software timing, two-host pipelined setup
method: The viewer issues both reacquisition click edges before awaiting their ordered host observations. The actual held-key press reply includes the source X11 held-key query. The dual metric uses viewer F12 issuance through receipt of the matching actual host X11 release event. The source timestamps the edge, then queries the source X11 held-key state and includes that proof in the same observer reply. The viewer-timed interval includes the source query and return link and is an upper bound on the actual host edge delay. Host monotonic offsets are never subtracted from viewer timestamps. Late replies during controlled failure teardown remain outside the measured arrays. Per-trial nearest-rank p95 uses all 100 planned slots and gives unverified samples infinite rank. The physical input-to-pixel target is outside this measurement.
